# Justin S. Henriksen

> AI-fluent executive and founder in Salt Lake City, Utah. Drives organization-wide AI adoption and transformation through influence rather than authority. Founder and CEO of GetLatest AI, building production multi-agent AI systems today. Former Microsoft Sr. Director who set AI/ML strategy across a US partner ecosystem of thousands of independent companies, none of whom reported to him.

Justin has been building software since 2004, as an engineer, architect, general manager, and founder. He led AI, data, and advanced analytics strategy for Microsoft's US partner ecosystem, ran P&Ls up to $51M as a CEO and general manager, and now builds and ships AI products at GetLatest AI. He still writes code.

## Career
- Founder and CEO, GetLatest AI and Fenix Venture (June 2024 to present). AI teams that embed into a client's operations, handling customer inquiries, scheduling, and follow-up, plus the marketing that brings new customers in.
- CEO and President, Blue Eye (April 2023 to June 2024). Grew a $5M P&L to $11M, led 150 people across three offices, moved EBITDA from a $250K monthly loss to a $125K monthly profit in six months, MRR $440K to $1.2M.
- CEO and General Manager, Crayon US (October 2021 to January 2023). Grew a $43M P&L to $51M, 200-person org, turned a licensing reseller into an AI, data, and managed services business, lifted services margin from -28% to +64%.
- Sr. Director, Partner Ecosystem, Microsoft (July 2017 to October 2021). Set AI/ML and data strategy across the US partner ecosystem. 30+ AI enablement initiatives on $1.5M of funding. Accelerated technical adoption 15x and platform adoption velocity 63%. Contributed to $100M+ in customer growth.
- Principal Software Engineer, Microsoft (September 2013 to June 2017). Azure adoption architecture, Cloud Center of Excellence reference patterns, the Azure SQL DTU Calculator.
- Software Engineering Manager, Microsoft (March 2012 to September 2013). Distributed systems for global data center infrastructure. Drove CI, automated testing, and deployment automation.
- Solutions Architect, LDS Church (July 2008 to March 2012). Architecture roadmaps across .Net, Java, PHP, SQL Server, Oracle, AWS, and Azure.
- Development Manager, TaxWorks (June 2004 to July 2008). Migrated 5,000+ pages from classic ASP to ASP.NET to enable SaaS. Cut $350K in maintenance cost, opened $700K in revenue, shipped under SAS 70, PCI, and FFIEC compliance.

## Products he builds
- GetLatest AI (https://getlatest.ai): AI teams that embed into a company's operations, plus AI-driven marketing.
- Snappy Agents (https://snappyagents.ai): Multi-tenant AI agent platform. Next.js application layer, Python worker services, Docker-based tenant isolation, human-in-the-loop approval boundaries.
- Helix (https://helixagency.ai): Go-to-market agent. Buying signals, prospect research, lead scoring, personalized outreach, SEO.
- Heimdall (https://heimdall.getlatest.ai): Competitive and market intelligence agent.
- Ronin (https://myronin.ai): AI job search agent.
- FindTime (https://find-time.ai): Scheduling platform built for AI agents.
